Elsewhere the chair answers his own 'Any comments? No comments.' inside one turn (00:03:07, and the old transcript put 'Any comments? No comments.' in one turn at 00:04:35), and pitch of these replies ( (pitch checked)) is close to the chair's ( (pitch checked)), so this may be Earl Funk; too thin to name.

speakers.label: B
speakers.title: Councillor
speakers.evidence: Chair at 00:00:13: 'give the opening to Councillor Susan Penner' and B gives the opening reflection at 00:00:21; minutes item 3: Councillor Susan Penner opened the meeting; pitch of the opening (pitch checked) (Susan Penner ~193).
speakers.notes: The two 'Nothing further.' turns (00:05:31, 00:09:59) measure  (pitch checked) (a man's voice) and are overridden to Unclear. Pre-meeting chatter at 00:00:02 kept on B.

speakers.label: C
speakers.title: Mayor
speakers.evidence: Calls the meeting to order (00:00:13), calls every motion and vote, hands the floor to Mr. Warkentin (00:07:12, 00:08:37) and to councillors; addressed as 'Mr. Mayor' in the replies; minutes: Mayor Earl Funk called the meeting to order.
speakers.notes: Mover/seconder names in C's turns are often misheard (e.g. 'Councillor Penner by Councillor Penner', 'Councillor Hiebert, seconded by Councillor Hebert'); the minutes have the correct movers. 'Move.' at 00:05:33 split off as another voice.

speakers.label: D

speakers.evidence: Each substantive D turn (00:05:00, 00:08:12, 00:09:47) follows the chair naming Councillor Zwaagstra as mover and 'Go ahead, Councillor'; minutes R22-288, R22-292, R22-293 moved by M. Zwaagstra; pitch checked (Zwaagstra ~104).
speakers.notes: 'Not at all.' at 00:08:34 is too short to measure; the old map thought it might be another voice.

speakers.evidence: Both E turns (00:07:28, 00:08:53) follow 'Mr. Warkentin, would you please introduce this file?' and present administration's recommendation; chair replies 'Thank you, Mr. Warkentin' (00:09:37); Zwaagstra then refers to 'the city manager'.

summary: Short, clean meeting: chair, Susan Penner, Zwaagstra and Warkentin are well separated. Letter A ('No comments.') and two 'Nothing further.' turns are unidentified short interjections; Damian Penner was absent.
